plainTranslation: Compatible values and affection with a spark of difference. You get along easily and complement each other's tastes. Failure mode: leaving the rapport unexamined. Use it; stay curious where you diverge.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your affections and tastes align. Ease, pleasure, and real enjoyment of each other. Let this be the low-drama center of the bond.
tension: This contact teaches something quietly important. The life you both want does not assemble itself out of good intentions. It gets built in small deliberate choices, the reservation made, the money set aside for the thing that matters, the ordinary evening someone decided to make nice on purpose.
advice: Act on what you both already value. Make the plan instead of imagining it. This connection gets richer every single time one of you turns the shared wanting into something you actually did, rather than something you both agreed would be lovely sometime.
